topography.project_purpose: Canonical Bridge. Structurally: 60 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 2 ERC20 tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 4 common project-authored base contract(s) (lib_addressresolver, abs_fraudcontributor, resourcemetering). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
